messages:
Aisha: Quick kickoff — Polaris dedicated bring-up. Need final quota (tokens/sec & concurrent sessions), autoscale policy, and a load-test plan we can run next Tue or Wed. Can CS get confirmation by EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Marco: On quotas: how many GPU slots did legal ops sign off on? I have 8 G5s reserved in the pool, which maps to ~1200 concurrent small-chat sessions.
Jen: We allocated 8 GPUs but the customer committed to a steady baseline of 600 rps and peak 1800 rps. Recommend we set quota headroom to 2200 rps for safety during initial cutover.
Aisha: That matches my notes. Can you put the 2200 in the ticket so billing/commitment aligns?
Marco: Will do. For autoscale, proposed policy: target CPU 60% and latency P95 < 300ms; scale up by 1 GPU per 1000 requests sustained for 30s, scale down after 5m cooldown. Thoughts?
Theo: Fine, but add a hard ceiling — no more than 12 GPUs without manual approval. Also add a burst window for 10m to allow controlled spikes from their onboarding load.
Jen: Agree on ceiling. Also enable a nonblocking fallback to a cheaper quantized model if we hit >10 GPUs, so user facing errors are minimized and cost doesn't explode.
Aisha: Good call. For load tests: propose two phases — (A) smoke: 30m at 50% baseline, (B) soak: 2h ramp from baseline -> peak -> 1.2x peak. Prefer Tue 09:00 PT for smoke, Wed 02:00 PT for soak (less customer traffic).
Marco: Wed 02:00 PT is maintenance window for infra team — we can support. What tool are we using?
Theo: Use loadtester-bot with distributed workers. Command to run generator: 
```
loadtester --target polaris.redwood.example --profile conversational --concurrency 1200 --ramp 30m --kv-cache=on
```
I'll drop the exact worker list in the Ops ticket.
loadtester-bot: scheduling job preview:
- session profile: conversational-short
- workers: 6 (us-west-2)
- estimated tokens/day: 9.8M
- dry-run available: yes
Jen: Add these checks to the runbook: throughput trace per route, KV cache hit%, error rate (5xx), and rollout revert trigger if client error spike >1% sustained for 2m.
Aisha: Also capture quality metrics — have the customer run 50 golden prompts against the canary variant and report diffs. If >12% of outputs degrade, we rollback.
Marco: I'll add alarms: infra_latency_p95, model_cpu_util, kv_hit_ratio, and cost burn monitor. Alert paging to eng-oncall and CS rotation.
Theo: For stripe-by-stripe traffic shift: shift 10% every 15 minutes for first hour, then 25% increments after validation. Each shift requires green checks from automations.
Aisha: Who owns the automation checks? I can own the quality gate; Marco takes infra checks; Theo verifies scaling and load.
Jen: I'll coordinate with customer for their golden prompt set and confirm availability for the two windows.
Aisha: Perfect. Action items:
- Jen: confirm golden prompts + customer availability (today EOD)
- Marco: create infra ticket with quotas, alarms, and manual ceiling (by EOD)
- Theo: create loadtester job and worker list, drop command & dry-run (by EOD)
